title: Adaptación y Resiliencia
organization: Dirección de Cambio Climático, Ministerio de Ambiente de Panamá
temporal_coverage: Official page describing local adaptation projects and climate-adaptation water programming; project dates are not consistently stated.
methodology: Official page text read; it summarizes ministry projects and objectives.
limitations: Undated page mixes completed activities with expected outputs; no impact evaluation.

title: Programa de Adaptación al Cambio Climático a través del Manejo Integrado de los Recursos Hídricos presenta resultados impactantes en cuencas priorizadas
organization: Dirección de Cambio Climático, Ministerio de Ambiente de Panamá
methodology: MiAmbiente summary of two watershed projects.
limitations: Implementer-reported; no evaluation or basin-specific beneficiary split.

title: Panama: National Case Study
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
temporal_coverage: Historical drought record and social/service indicators with vintages mainly from 2013 and 2021–2023.
methodology: FAO drought-portal country profile presents selected hazard pathways and social, economic and infrastructure indicators.
limitations: Underlying datasets and methods are not detailed on this profile; indicator years differ and are not current estimates.

title: Agua y el Canal
temporal_coverage: Live water-management page with 2023 drought facts and planning information current at October 2026 access.
methodology: Canal Authority page describes water operations, service areas and water-project planning.
limitations: Institutional account, not independent assessment; dated facts and live-page material are distinguished.

title: Parlamentarios británicos visitan la comunidad de Gardi Sugdub en la comarca Guna Yala
temporal_coverage: Official account of a January 2024 visit and then-planned relocation to Isberyala.
methodology: Ministry press account of a site visit and discussion with Guna Congress participants and Sáhilas.
limitations: Dated event report, not a household survey or follow-up on completion, consent or service delivery.

title: Fenómeno de El Niño – SINAPROC
organization: Sistema Nacional de Protección Civil, Panamá
temporal_coverage: 2026 El Niño alert, emergency declaration and July–December 2026 outlook as stated on the live page.
methodology: Civil-protection page summarizes official meteorological and hydrological monitoring and response arrangements.
limitations: Forecast lacks model/scenario details; response descriptions are not evaluation results.
